### Card.Root

<ParamField body="Root.backgroundColor" type="string">
  CSS background color of the outer card. Child sections have their own backgrounds.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.children" type="ReactNode">
  Card sections or other content.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.className" type="string">
  CSS class merged with the part class.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.fullWidth" type="boolean">
  Sets the card width to 100% of its container.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.ref" type="Ref&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;">
  Ref to the default div, or the element supplied through render.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.render" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, {}&gt;">
  Element or render callback composed through Base UI useRender. Supply native button or link attributes on the rendered owner.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.style" type="CSSProperties">
  Native styles applied to the rendered part.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.variant" type="&quot;compact&quot; | &quot;default&quot;" default="default">
  default keeps the standard section appearance. compact uses secondary section backgrounds, 8px header and footer padding, 8px horizontal content padding without vertical padding, and no header divider.
</ParamField>

### Card.Action

<ParamField body="Action.children" type="ReactNode">
  Optional content inside the stretched action. Supply an accessible name for empty actions.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.className" type="string">

<ParamField body="Action.disabled" type="boolean" default="false">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.ref" type="Ref&lt;HTMLButtonElement&gt;">
  Ref to the default button, or the element supplied through render.

  Native element or render callback composed through Base UI useRender. Links retain native navigation and labels activate their associated controls without an additional keyboard target.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.style" type="CSSProperties">
  Native styles applied to the rendered action.
</ParamField>
